deadline_text: The program page is out of date. It only shows June 23 to 27, 2025 and says registration is closed for TOTAL 2023. Email techrecruit@purdue.edu to ask about the next camp before you apply.

name: TOTAL Camp (Turned Onto Technology and Leadership)
what_you_do: A week on the Purdue campus to learn about tech degrees. You work on a week long project with Polytechnic teachers. You earn one college credit.
who_can_apply: Rising 10th and 11th graders. Age limit not stated.
notes: This page looks old (2025 dates). Check Purdue Polytechnic and the Summer College site for current dates and cost before planning. The 2025 page lists $350 per person, including activities, lodging, meals and a camp t-shirt.
